items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a session expiration vulnerability that prevents automatic logoff because the Eye Exam form's read-only poll omits skip_timeout_reset. Attackers with physical access to an unattended workstation can use the still-active session to view patient health information, since update_READONLY() resets the idle timer every 15 seconds.

items.title: CVE-2026-126428: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows authenticated billing users to store attacker-controlled PHP by uploading a malformed ERA file to er
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows authenticated billing users to store attacker-controlled PHP by uploading a malformed ERA file to era_payments.php. Attackers with a database-write primitive such as SQL injection can register a background_services row whose require_once loads the stored .edi file, executing PHP as the web-server user.

items.title: CVE-2026-126429: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 passes authenticated user-controlled HTML from the doc_lib.php content parameter to mPDF, which resolves local files and nested SVG resources. Authenticated pa
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 passes authenticated user-controlled HTML from the doc_lib.php content parameter to mPDF, which resolves local files and nested SVG resources. Authenticated patients or core users can submit crafted CSS imports or php://filter SVG references to read arbitrary server files including credentials and OAuth keys.

items.title: CVE-2026-126430: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows any authenticated core user to inject SQL by supplying crafted patient_data field names to the CCR revandap
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows any authenticated core user to inject SQL by supplying crafted patient_data field names to the CCR revandapprove controller. Attackers can embed scalar subqueries in the UPDATE patient_data SET clause to read staff password hashes and portal reset values, alter arbitrary patient demographics, and take over patient-portal accounts.

items.title: CVE-2026-126431: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a second-order sql injection vulnerability that allows authenticated Carecoordination users to store malicious C-CDA field identifiers through the sav
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a second-order sql injection vulnerability that allows authenticated Carecoordination users to store malicious C-CDA field identifiers through the savedata action. Attackers can inject SQL into the IN clause built by fetchFormValues() during C-CDA generation to extract password hashes, portal reset values, and patient records.

items.title: CVE-2026-126432: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in interface/orders/list_reports.php that allows read-only users to transmit lab orders because the patients/m
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in interface/orders/list_reports.php that allows read-only users to transmit lab orders because the patients/med check ignores write permission. Authenticated attackers can submit form_xmit with arbitrary procedure order IDs to send HL7 orders containing SSNs, insurance, and diagnoses to laboratories and mark them transmitted.

items.title: CVE-2026-126421: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows authenticated users with patients/med access to exhaust PHP workers via an unbounded co
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows authenticated users with patients/med access to exhaust PHP workers via an unbounded count parameter. Attackers can send print_labels requests to labs_ajax.php with huge counts, forcing mPDF page and barcode generation that makes OpenEMR unavailable.

items.title: CVE-2026-126422: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in library/ajax/lists_touch.php that allows restricted authenticated users to mark another patient's clinical li
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in library/ajax/lists_touch.php that allows restricted authenticated users to mark another patient's clinical lists as reviewed. Attackers can submit arbitrary patient_id and type values to falsely record "None known" allergy, medication, or problem lists, misleading clinicians and skewing quality-measure calculations.

items.title: CVE-2026-126423: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability in four ZIP upload paths that read uncompressed entries into memory without size or ratio checks. Authenticated bill
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability in four ZIP upload paths that read uncompressed entries into memory without size or ratio checks. Authenticated billing or Carecoordination users can upload highly compressed ZIP archives to exhaust PHP memory and worker pools, making OpenEMR unavailable.

items.title: CVE-2026-126424: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows users with admin/superbill write permission to inject HTML into SNOMED code descriptions via s
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows users with admin/superbill write permission to inject HTML into SNOMED code descriptions via superbill_custom_full.php. When a clinician selects the malicious code, the Functional and Cognitive Status form or fee-sheet forms assign it to innerHTML, executing JavaScript in the clinician's session to read patient data and perform actions.

items.title: CVE-2026-126425: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a stored SQL injection vulnerability in which History layout field identifiers saved through edit_layout.php, including HIS fields and LBF source-H fi
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a stored SQL injection vulnerability in which History layout field identifiers saved through edit_layout.php, including HIS fields and LBF source-H fields, are placed unvalidated into an INSERT statement for patients without a history_data row. Users with admin/super and patients/med write access can trigger history_save.php or LBF saves to execute SQL functions like SLEEP, tying up database workers or accessing data beyond their privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-126426: OpenEMR 5.0.2 before 8.5.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in mfa_registrations.php and mfa_u2f.php that allows session hijackers to delete MFA factors or register
items.summary: OpenEMR 5.0.2 before 8.5.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in mfa_registrations.php and mfa_u2f.php that allows session hijackers to delete MFA factors or register U2F keys without password re-entry. Attackers holding a victim's authenticated session can remove all second factors or add their own U2F key, bypassing MFA at later logins with the password.

items.title: CVE-2026-126416: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in patient_tracker_status.php that allows low-privilege authenticated users to modify other patients' tracker
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in patient_tracker_status.php that allows low-privilege authenticated users to modify other patients' tracker entries by supplying arbitrary tracker_id values. Attackers can post statustype and roomnum parameters with a valid CSRF token to alter patient-flow status, room assignments, and linked calendar appointment state.

items.title: CVE-2026-126417: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an access control flaw in get_claim_file.php: with location=tmp, it serves any file in the shared temporary directory without verifying the file is a
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an access control flaw in get_claim_file.php: with location=tmp, it serves any file in the shared temporary directory without verifying the file is a claim for the caller. Users with acct/eob or acct/bill write access can request key=ccda.xml to download the most recently validated patient's complete C-CDA clinical document.

items.title: CVE-2026-126418: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in interface/billing/sl_eob_invoice.php, which escapes billing codes for HTML attributes but not for JavaS
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in interface/billing/sl_eob_invoice.php, which escapes billing codes for HTML attributes but not for JavaScript strings in an inline onkeyup handler. Clinicians with encounter coding access can save crafted billing codes through diagnosis.php that execute script when a Back Office user enters a payment, exposing patient and financial data or performing actions as that user.

items.title: CVE-2026-126419: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the esign_form_submit handler of library/ESign/Form/Controller.php that verifies only the caller's password,
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the esign_form_submit handler of library/ESign/Form/Controller.php that verifies only the caller's password, not access to the patient, encounter, or form type. Authenticated core users can supply arbitrary formId, formDir, and encounterId values to sign and lock any patient's clinical form, creating unauthorized approval records and blocking normal editing.

items.title: CVE-2026-126420: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the FaxSMS module's utility.php that allows read-only demographics users to create patient charts. Attackers
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the FaxSMS module's utility.php that allows read-only demographics users to create patient charts. Attackers can submit the form_create request with chosen identity fields to create fictitious or duplicate patients with employer, history, and insurance records.

items.title: CVE-2026-126409: Wasmtime 47.0.0 before 48.0.8, 49.0.0 before 49.0.5, and 50.0.0 before 50.0.1 contains a cross-engine type confusion vulnerability because StructType::with_finality_and_supertype d
items.summary: Wasmtime 47.0.0 before 48.0.8, 49.0.0 before 49.0.5, and 50.0.0 before 50.0.1 contains a cross-engine type confusion vulnerability because StructType::with_finality_and_supertype does not validate that the supplied supertype belongs to the same Engine. Embedders using multiple engines that create a GC struct type with another engine's supertype can trigger runtime panics or GC heap corruption, causing denial of service; guest WebAssembly cannot trigger it.

items.title: CVE-2026-126410: Wasmtime's wasmtime-wasi crate 48.0.0 before 48.0.8, 49.0.0 before 49.0.5, and 50.0.0 before 50.0.1 contains a time-of-check/time-of-use race in the wasip3 wasi:sockets udp-socket
items.summary: Wasmtime's wasmtime-wasi crate 48.0.0 before 48.0.8, 49.0.0 before 49.0.5, and 50.0.0 before 50.0.1 contains a time-of-check/time-of-use race in the wasip3 wasi:sockets udp-socket host implementation that lets guests bypass socket_addr_check send restrictions. A malicious guest can race udp-socket.send against udp-socket.connect to deliver attacker-controlled datagrams to addresses the policy permits only for receiving.

items.title: CVE-2026-126411: Frappe HRMS 16.0.0 before 16.50.0 lacks authorization checks on certain HR workflow endpoints, letting authenticated users access records they are not permitted to view. Any logged
items.summary: Frappe HRMS 16.0.0 before 16.50.0 lacks authorization checks on certain HR workflow endpoints, letting authenticated users access records they are not permitted to view. Any logged-in user, including one with only the Employee role, can read candidate record details and employee email addresses, and cause emails to be sent to employees.

items.title: CVE-2026-126412: Frappe HRMS 15.0.0 before 15.64.1 and 16.0.0 before 16.19.0 lacks a write permission check on a bulk record processing action, allowing users with only read access to the related s
items.summary: Frappe HRMS 15.0.0 before 15.64.1 and 16.0.0 before 16.19.0 lacks a write permission check on a bulk record processing action, allowing users with only read access to the related setup record to modify data. Authenticated users with the default Employee role can run the action to create and submit records for every covered employee.

items.title: CVE-2026-126413: Frappe HRMS 15.x before 15.64.1 and 16.x before 16.19.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an endpoint that returns file information, allowing authenticated users to
items.summary: Frappe HRMS 15.x before 15.64.1 and 16.x before 16.19.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an endpoint that returns file information, allowing authenticated users to read details of files attached to records they cannot access. Any logged-in user, including one with only the Employee role, can query it to view attachment details on any document type and confirm record existence.

items.title: CVE-2026-126414: Frappe HRMS 15.0.0 before 15.64.2 and 16.0.0 before 16.20.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in certain record update endpoints that lack an ownership check. Authenti
items.summary: Frappe HRMS 15.0.0 before 15.64.2 and 16.0.0 before 16.20.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in certain record update endpoints that lack an ownership check. Authenticated users with the Employee role can call these endpoints to modify records belonging to other employees, beyond their permitted role.

items.title: CVE-2026-126415: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the Patient Validation module that allows any authenticated user to retrieve patient demographic records. Att
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the Patient Validation module that allows any authenticated user to retrieve patient demographic records. Attackers can send direct requests with wildcard mf_lname or empty mf_ parameters to the patientvalidation endpoint to enumerate the entire patient_data table.

items.title: CVE-2026-126404: Coder 2.28.0 before 2.29.24, 2.30.0 before 2.34.16, 2.35.0 before 2.36.11, 2.37.0 before 2.37.8, and 2.38.0 before 2.38.4 does not restrict new API keys to the creating token's sco
items.summary: Coder 2.28.0 before 2.29.24, 2.30.0 before 2.34.16, 2.35.0 before 2.36.11, 2.37.0 before 2.37.8, and 2.38.0 before 2.38.4 does not restrict new API keys to the creating token's scopes, allow list, or expiry. A scoped API key or OAuth2 token holding key-creation permission can call POST /api/v2/users/{user}/keys/tokens to mint longer-lived coder:all keys, gaining the user's full privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-126405: Coder 2.21.0 before 2.29.24, 2.30.0 before 2.34.16, 2.35.0 before 2.36.11, 2.37.0 before 2.37.8, and 2.38.0 before 2.38.4 reads Web Push endpoint responses in webpushSend with io.R
items.summary: Coder 2.21.0 before 2.29.24, 2.30.0 before 2.34.16, 2.35.0 before 2.36.11, 2.37.0 before 2.37.8, and 2.38.0 before 2.38.4 reads Web Push endpoint responses in webpushSend with io.ReadAll, without a size limit or client timeout. Any authenticated user can register a subscription via POST /api/v2/users/{user}/webpush/subscription pointing to a server returning an endless body, exhausting coderd memory and crashing the API, dashboard, and workspace connections.

items.title: CVE-2026-126406: The wasmtime-wasi-http p2 implementation in Wasmtime before 36.0.20, 37.0.0 before 48.0.8, 49.0.0 before 49.0.5, and 50.0.0 before 50.0.1 can send conflicting content-length header
items.summary: The wasmtime-wasi-http p2 implementation in Wasmtime before 36.0.20, 37.0.0 before 48.0.8, 49.0.0 before 49.0.5, and 50.0.0 before 50.0.1 can send conflicting content-length headers, or ones not matching the body, in outgoing requests. A guest that reuses a received response's headers resource to send a bodyless request can enable request smuggling against non-compliant servers, potentially bypassing embedder destination access controls.

items.title: CVE-2026-126407: Wasmtime before 36.0.20, 37.0.0 before 48.0.8, 49.0.0 before 49.0.5, and 50.0.0 before 50.0.1 allocates untracked host memory when a component receives a borrow of a resource it de
items.summary: Wasmtime before 36.0.20, 37.0.0 before 48.0.8, 49.0.0 before 49.0.5, and 50.0.0 before 50.0.1 allocates untracked host memory when a component receives a borrow of a resource it defines itself, bypassing the per-store handle limit. A malicious guest component can repeatedly transfer such borrowed resources to consume arbitrary host memory, causing denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-126408: Wasmtime 47.0.0 before 48.0.8, 49.0.0 before 49.0.5, and 50.0.0 before 50.0.1 contains an insufficient type-check in the TypedFunc embedder API for I31, Option , and Option<Non
items.summary: Wasmtime 47.0.0 before 48.0.8, 49.0.0 before 49.0.5, and 50.0.0 before 50.0.1 contains an insufficient type-check in the TypedFunc embedder API for I31, Option , and Option parameter or result types, reaching an unreachable!() path. A malicious guest module exporting a function that uses another anyref-hierarchy type can panic the host embedding, causing denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-126398: vLLM from 0.28.0 before 0.30.0 contains a reachable assertion vulnerability in GPUModelRunner._init_xdrope_positions that allows remote attackers to crash the engine by submitting
items.summary: vLLM from 0.28.0 before 0.30.0 contains a reachable assertion vulnerability in GPUModelRunner._init_xdrope_positions that allows remote attackers to crash the engine by submitting embeddings-only requests. Attackers can send a /v1/completions request containing only prompt_embeds to XD-RoPE models with --enable-prompt-embeds, terminating the EngineCore and API server for all clients.

items.title: CVE-2026-126399: vLLM from 0.19.0 before 0.31.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability that allows inference clients to bypass the server frame limit by setting media_io_kwargs.video.num_fram
items.summary: vLLM from 0.19.0 before 0.31.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability that allows inference clients to bypass the server frame limit by setting media_io_kwargs.video.num_frames in chat completion requests. Attackers can supply num_frames=-1 or a large value with many base64 JPEG frames, forcing VideoMediaIO to decode all frames and np.stack them, causing memory exhaustion.

items.title: CVE-2026-126400: Password Pusher from 1.49.0 before 2.17.0 contains an IP spoofing vulnerability that allows remote clients to forge the recorded request IP via unanchored trusted-proxy regular exp
items.summary: Password Pusher from 1.49.0 before 2.17.0 contains an IP spoofing vulnerability that allows remote clients to forge the recorded request IP via unanchored trusted-proxy regular expressions. Clients in 110.0.0.0/8 or 210.0.0.0/8, or connecting directly, can supply X-Forwarded-For values to falsify audit log entries and shift password generator rate limits.

items.title: CVE-2026-126401: Fleet before 4.86.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust server memory through quadratic XML canonicalization of unsigned SAM
items.summary: Fleet before 4.86.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust server memory through quadratic XML canonicalization of unsigned SAML responses. Attackers can send a single crafted SAML response with deeply nested elements declaring new namespace prefixes to POST /api/v1/fleet/sso/callback, crashing the Fleet server.

items.title: CVE-2026-126402: Fleet before 4.89.0 contains an incorrect authorization flaw in its user administration API that accepts user creation or modification when the caller administers any one of the as
items.summary: Fleet before 4.89.0 contains an incorrect authorization flaw in its user administration API that accepts user creation or modification when the caller administers any one of the assigned teams. Authenticated team administrators can grant users administrator roles on other teams, then deploy software and execute scripts on those teams' hosts.

items.title: CVE-2026-126403: Coder 2.26.0 before 2.29.24, 2.30.0 before 2.34.16, 2.35.0 before 2.36.11, 2.37.0 before 2.37.8, and 2.38.0 before 2.38.4 contains an improper authorization flaw in the external ag
items.summary: Coder 2.26.0 before 2.29.24, 2.30.0 before 2.34.16, 2.35.0 before 2.36.11, 2.37.0 before 2.37.8, and 2.38.0 before 2.38.4 contains an improper authorization flaw in the external agent credentials endpoint, which returns the workspace agent token to users with only workspace read access rather than ssh permission. Authenticated users with roles such as Template Admin or Organization Admin can use the token to read the owner's private Git SSH key and Git provider OAuth tokens, and impersonate the agent to receive the owner's sessions.

items.title: CVE-2026-126392: Parse Server from 9.10.6-alpha.1 before 9.10.8-alpha.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows clients with write but not read access to learn whether fields a
items.summary: Parse Server from 9.10.6-alpha.1 before 9.10.8-alpha.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows clients with write but not read access to learn whether fields are stored on MongoDB. Attackers can send updates with dot notation operations on top-level fields and observe internal server errors versus success responses to infer field existence.

items.title: CVE-2026-126393: SiYuan before 3.8.10 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the skill-install download path because fetchBytes performs only a parse-time hostname check instead of
items.summary: SiYuan before 3.8.10 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the skill-install download path because fetchBytes performs only a parse-time hostname check instead of using ssrfSafeClient. Attackers can supply a skill URL via the MCP skill install action that redirects or DNS-rebinds to loopback addresses, reaching internal services and metadata endpoints.

items.title: CVE-2026-126394: vLLM 0.30.0 before 0.31.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability in OpenCVDynamicOpenPanguVideoBackend, which uses request-controlled num_frames without an effective ceiling.
items.summary: vLLM 0.30.0 before 0.31.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability in OpenCVDynamicOpenPanguVideoBackend, which uses request-controlled num_frames without an effective ceiling. Unauthenticated attackers can send /v1/chat/completions or /tokenize requests selecting the openpangu video_backend with a huge num_frames, forcing np.linspace allocations and CPU work that OOM-kill the API server.

items.title: CVE-2026-126395: vLLM from 0.14.0rc1 before 0.31.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in sanitize_message() whose lowercase-only regex fails to scrub uppercase PIL image addresses. Un
items.summary: vLLM from 0.14.0rc1 before 0.31.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in sanitize_message() whose lowercase-only regex fails to scrub uppercase PIL image addresses. Unauthenticated attackers can send a crafted PNG to endpoints such as /tokenize, triggering HF-processor errors that leak live server heap addresses useful for ASLR bypass.

items.title: CVE-2026-126396: vLLM from 0.24.0 before 0.31.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability in the MiniMax M3 VL video processor, which accepts request-level min_pixels without range or min_pixels
items.summary: vLLM from 0.24.0 before 0.31.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability in the MiniMax M3 VL video processor, which accepts request-level min_pixels without range or min_pixels <= max_pixels validation. Its video-wide pixel budget is enforced only when max_long_side_pixel is set, and that value defaults to None. API clients can supply a large min_pixels via mm_processor_kwargs to enlarge every decoded frame, causing excessive CPU and host-memory consumption that may disrupt workers or the service.

items.title: CVE-2026-126397: vLLM from 0.10.1 before 0.31.0 forwards a request-controlled mm_processor_kwargs.max_patches value to the Hugging Face processor for Cohere2 Vision models without a server-side upp
items.summary: vLLM from 0.10.1 before 0.31.0 forwards a request-controlled mm_processor_kwargs.max_patches value to the Hugging Face processor for Cohere2 Vision models without a server-side upper bound, causing quadratic CPU work during multimodal preprocessing. Remote clients can send small image chat-completion requests with large, varying max_patches values to bypass the LRU cache, exhaust preprocessing workers, and deny service to other clients.

items.title: CVE-2026-126387: n8n before 2.46.1 contains an arbitrary file read vulnerability that allows authenticated members to read server files by supplying absolute paths to the Browser Use browser_upload
items.summary: n8n before 2.46.1 contains an arbitrary file read vulnerability that allows authenticated members to read server files by supplying absolute paths to the Browser Use browser_upload tool. Attackers with a connected remote browser session can have Playwright read files such as instance configuration from the n8n server and retrieve their contents from the page.

items.title: CVE-2026-126388: n8n before 2.46.1 contains a credential exposure vulnerability that forwards Authorization headers and basic auth credentials on cross-origin redirects because sendCredentialsOnCro
items.summary: n8n before 2.46.1 contains a credential exposure vulnerability that forwards Authorization headers and basic auth credentials on cross-origin redirects because sendCredentialsOnCrossOriginRedirect defaults to true. Attackers controlling a redirect target or an expression-fed URL in credential-using nodes can capture stored workflow credentials sent to their endpoint.

items.title: CVE-2026-126389: n8n before 1.123.89 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the Chat Trigger that allows unauthenticated attackers to skip n8n User Auth through the setup GET webhook ro
items.summary: n8n before 1.123.89 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the Chat Trigger that allows unauthenticated attackers to skip n8n User Auth through the setup GET webhook route in embedded chat mode. Attackers can send unauthenticated GET requests to the chat webhook URL to read named session conversation history or trigger workflows with attacker-supplied input.

items.title: CVE-2026-126390: n8n before 1.123.89 contains a credential leakage vulnerability in the NocoDB node that sends the configured NocoDB API token to attacker-chosen hosts when downloading attachments.
items.summary: n8n before 1.123.89 contains a credential leakage vulnerability in the NocoDB node that sends the configured NocoDB API token to attacker-chosen hosts when downloading attachments. Attackers with write access to a NocoDB attachment cell can insert a URL to their host, capturing the API token when the workflow executes with Download Attachments enabled.

items.title: CVE-2026-126391: n8n before 1.123.89 contains an insufficient isolation vulnerability in workflow expression evaluation that allows authenticated users to escape the sandbox. Attackers with permiss
items.summary: n8n before 1.123.89 contains an insufficient isolation vulnerability in workflow expression evaluation that allows authenticated users to escape the sandbox. Attackers with permission to create or modify workflows can craft expressions referencing unexpected JavaScript properties to execute arbitrary code on the n8n host.

items.title: CVE-2026-126382: n8n before 2.38.0 and 3.x before 3.0.1 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the Asana Trigger that accepts a new webhook verification secret from any request carrying
items.summary: n8n before 2.38.0 and 3.x before 3.0.1 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the Asana Trigger that accepts a new webhook verification secret from any request carrying an X-Hook-Secret header. Unauthenticated attackers who know the webhook URL can replace the secret, send forged Asana events that pass signature verification, and trigger workflows with attacker-controlled data while genuine deliveries are rejected.

items.title: CVE-2026-126383: n8n before 1.123.89, 2.x before 2.45.5, 2.46.x before 2.46.1, and 3.x before 3.0.1 contains a NoSQL injection vulnerability in the MongoDB node's Update and Find And Replace operat
items.summary: n8n before 1.123.89, 2.x before 2.45.5, 2.46.x before 2.46.1, and 3.x before 3.0.1 contains a NoSQL injection vulnerability in the MongoDB node's Update and Find And Replace operations due to insufficient validation of the update key value taken from incoming items. Attackers who can supply untrusted input, such as a webhook body, to a workflow using these operations can make the node match and overwrite unintended documents or insert new documents in the MongoDB database.

items.title: CVE-2026-126384: n8n before 1.123.89, 2.x before 2.45.5, 2.46.x before 2.46.1, and 3.x before 3.0.1 bundles a GraphicsMagick version with known vulnerabilities in its official Docker image, which t
items.summary: n8n before 1.123.89, 2.x before 2.45.5, 2.46.x before 2.46.1, and 3.x before 3.0.1 bundles a GraphicsMagick version with known vulnerabilities in its official Docker image, which the Edit Image node uses to process images. Attackers who can supply crafted untrusted images to an Edit Image workflow, such as one fed by a Webhook node, can execute code on the n8n instance.

items.title: CVE-2026-126385: n8n before 2.45.5, 2.46.x before 2.46.1, and 3.x before 3.0.1 contains a flaw in the OAuth2 credential callback of the dynamic-credential connect flow, which does not verify that t
items.summary: n8n before 2.45.5, 2.46.x before 2.46.1, and 3.x before 3.0.1 contains a flaw in the OAuth2 credential callback of the dynamic-credential connect flow, which does not verify that the completing browser belongs to the user who started the flow. Members with access to a resolvable OAuth2 credential can send the provider authorization URL to a victim; if the victim consents without an active n8n session, the victim's tokens are stored under the member's identity, letting the member's workflows act as the victim.

items.title: CVE-2026-126386: n8n before 1.123.89, 2.x before 2.45.5, 2.46.x before 2.46.1, and 3.x before 3.0.1 contains an open redirect vulnerability in the unauthenticated MCP OAuth dynamic client registrat
items.summary: n8n before 1.123.89, 2.x before 2.45.5, 2.46.x before 2.46.1, and 3.x before 3.0.1 contains an open redirect vulnerability in the unauthenticated MCP OAuth dynamic client registration flow, which accepts arbitrary redirect_uri values via the /mcp-oauth/register endpoint. Attackers can send victims crafted /mcp-oauth/authorize URLs that redirect them to attacker-controlled sites before instance checks run, enabling phishing.

items.title: CVE-2026-126376: Vvveb 1.0.8.4 through 1.0.8.6 contains an incomplete authorization fix that allows low-privilege authors and vendors to access other users' records by bypassing admin_id owner scop
items.summary: Vvveb 1.0.8.4 through 1.0.8.6 contains an incomplete authorization fix that allows low-privilege authors and vendors to access other users' records by bypassing admin_id owner scoping. Attackers can supply filter[admin_id] to list drafts, invoke duplicate() on posts or products, or enumerate every vendor's digital-asset metadata.

items.title: CVE-2026-126377: Vvveb before 1.0.9.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in generateCookie() in system/user/user.php that uses loose comparison to validate MD5 cookie hashes. Unauthent
items.summary: Vvveb before 1.0.9.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in generateCookie() in system/user/user.php that uses loose comparison to validate MD5 cookie hashes. Unauthenticated attackers can brute-force cookie values until the server's MD5 computation yields a 0e magic hash, then forge persistent cookies for account takeover.

items.title: CVE-2026-126378: Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains a file upload vulnerability in the theme installer validFile() function that uses strpos() instead of strict path matching. Attackers with admin cred
items.summary: Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains a file upload vulnerability in the theme installer validFile() function that uses strpos() instead of strict path matching. Attackers with admin credentials can upload a ZIP containing a PHP file whose path includes /theme.php to achieve remote code execution on nginx deployments.

items.title: CVE-2026-126379: Vvveb 1.0.8.6 contains an incomplete server-side request forgery fix that allows authenticated admin users to bypass DNS pinning by requesting non-443 URLs. Attackers can supply a
items.summary: Vvveb 1.0.8.6 contains an incomplete server-side request forgery fix that allows authenticated admin users to bypass DNS pinning by requesting non-443 URLs. Attackers can supply a rebinding hostname to the editor oEmbedProxy url parameter to read loopback services, internal panels, and cloud metadata credentials.

items.title: CVE-2026-126380: Vvveb before 1.0.9.0 contains a denylist bypass in system/traits/media.php where '.phar' is misconfigured with a leading dot, allowing authenticated administrators to upload .phar
items.summary: Vvveb before 1.0.9.0 contains a denylist bypass in system/traits/media.php where '.phar' is misconfigured with a leading dot, allowing authenticated administrators to upload .phar PHP files. Attackers can upload a GIF magic-byte polyglot webshell bypassing binary inspection and execute arbitrary OS commands as the web-server user.

items.title: CVE-2026-126381: n8n before 2.43.5, 2.44.x before 2.44.1, and 3.x before 3.0.1 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in the Vector Store (OracleDB) node, which does not validate Metadata Filter k
items.summary: n8n before 2.43.5, 2.44.x before 2.44.1, and 3.x before 3.0.1 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in the Vector Store (OracleDB) node, which does not validate Metadata Filter keys used in vector search queries. Attackers can supply crafted filter keys through untrusted workflow input such as webhooks to read data accessible to the configured Oracle credential.

items.title: CVE-2026-126370: Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains a remote code execution vulnerability allowing restricted site_admin roles to inject PHP by saving .sql files through the admin code editor. Attacker
items.summary: Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains a remote code execution vulnerability allowing restricted site_admin roles to inject PHP by saving .sql files through the admin code editor. Attackers can bypass extension and content deny-lists with an @IF macro payload that compiles into executable PHP when the model loads, running OS commands as the web user.

items.title: CVE-2026-126371: Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in Admin_Auth_TokenSQL::update(), which interpolates admin_auth_token array keys into an INSERT column list without a
items.summary: Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in Admin_Auth_TokenSQL::update(), which interpolates admin_auth_token array keys into an INSERT column list without a column whitelist or backtick escaping. Authenticated admin-panel users can submit backtick-containing keys to the admin/auth-token save action to inject comments and column identifiers into the SQL statement.

items.title: CVE-2026-126372: Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains an incomplete fix for CVE-2026-41934 that allows authenticated editor or site_admin users to write server-side templates by bypassing save restrictio
items.summary: Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains an incomplete fix for CVE-2026-41934 that allows authenticated editor or site_admin users to write server-side templates by bypassing save restrictions. Attackers can upload or rename .tpl files via editor/code upload and rename actions, or evade isExecutableFile checks in save(), to inject PHP code into templates.

items.title: CVE-2026-126373: Vvveb 1.0.8.4 through 1.0.8.6 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the content/revisions revision action that lets low-privileged Authors read other authors' revisions
items.summary: Vvveb 1.0.8.4 through 1.0.8.6 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the content/revisions revision action that lets low-privileged Authors read other authors' revisions. Attackers can supply a post_id, language_id, and created_at timestamp to retrieve private unpublished drafts, because the revision() action lacks the admin_id ownership restriction.

items.title: CVE-2026-126374: Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains an SQL injection vulnerability because the @KEYS(:each) macro emits PHP array keys as backtick-quoted INSERT column names without escaping, and sever
items.summary: Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains an SQL injection vulnerability because the @KEYS(:each) macro emits PHP array keys as backtick-quoted INSERT column names without escaping, and several procedures in admin/sql/mysqli/product.sql and admin_auth_token.sql omit the @FILTER guard. Authenticated back-office users able to save products can submit product_ POST array keys containing backticks to redirect bound values into unexposed columns or break SQL statements.

items.title: CVE-2026-126375: Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows low-privilege vendors to rename, delete, or overwrite other vendors' digital-asset files in the sha
items.summary: Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows low-privilege vendors to rename, delete, or overwrite other vendors' digital-asset files in the shared storage/digital_assets directory. Attackers can send rename, delete, or upload requests to product/digital-asset with another vendor's filename to break downloads or substitute malicious content.

items.title: CVE-2026-126319: Dockhand before 1.0.55 contains an arbitrary file read vulnerability that allows authenticated users with stacks:create permission to read sensitive files by supplying an arbitrary
items.summary: Dockhand before 1.0.55 contains an arbitrary file read vulnerability that allows authenticated users with stacks:create permission to read sensitive files by supplying an arbitrary composePath during stack adoption. Attackers can adopt a stack pointing to the encryption key, SQLite database, or /proc/self/environ and read it via the compose endpoint to obtain all stored credentials.

items.title: CVE-2026-126320: Dockhand before 1.0.55 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that lets users holding only containers:view download arbitrary container files instead of requiring contain
items.summary: Dockhand before 1.0.55 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that lets users holding only containers:view download arbitrary container files instead of requiring containers:exec. Authenticated Enterprise RBAC users can request any path from the files/download endpoint, which reads through Docker's archive API, to retrieve secrets, keys, and mounted credentials.

items.title: CVE-2026-126321: Dockhand before 1.0.55 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated users with stacks:edit to bypass the file-browser path guard by combining symlinks with '..
items.summary: Dockhand before 1.0.55 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated users with stacks:edit to bypass the file-browser path guard by combining symlinks with '..' sequences. Attackers can read /proc/self/environ, the SQLite database, and the encryption key via /api/system/files/content, or move them using the stack relocate endpoint, exposing stored credentials.

items.title: CVE-2026-126322: OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains an unsanitized deserialization vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to control patient-matching criteria by supplying a crafted serialize
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains an unsanitized deserialization vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to control patient-matching criteria by supplying a crafted serialized key parameter. Attackers can send serialized arrays to interface/orders/patient_match_dialog.php to enumerate patients or force matches that associate lab orders with the wrong patient.

items.title: CVE-2026-126323: Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability that allows attackers to perform admin state-changing actions because checkCsrf() in admin/controller/base
items.summary: Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability that allows attackers to perform admin state-changing actions because checkCsrf() in admin/controller/base.php only validates tokens for POST requests. Attackers can lure a logged-in admin into loading a forged cross-site GET request to delete admin/user accounts, sites, orders, and menus or change comment status.

items.title: CVE-2026-126369: Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows low-privilege author or vendor users to inject script by bypassing the regex blacklist in san
items.summary: Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows low-privilege author or vendor users to inject script by bypassing the regex blacklist in sanitizeHTML(). Attackers can save post or product content with unclosed event-handler tags or javascript: entities to execute script for anonymous visitors and admins, enabling session or CSRF-token theft.

items.title: CVE-2026-126313: Frappe HRMS 16.0.0 before 16.20.1 contains an authorization bypass because an ownership check is missing on a record type that employees can create. Authenticated users holding onl
items.summary: Frappe HRMS 16.0.0 before 16.20.1 contains an authorization bypass because an ownership check is missing on a record type that employees can create. Authenticated users holding only the Employee role can create or change draft records for another employee, or for a company they do not belong to.

items.title: CVE-2026-126314: Frappe HRMS 15.0.0 before 15.64.6 and 16.0.0 before 16.20.1 does not check access to each employee on endpoints that create records in bulk for a list of employees. An authenticate
items.summary: Frappe HRMS 15.0.0 before 15.64.6 and 16.0.0 before 16.20.1 does not check access to each employee on endpoints that create records in bulk for a list of employees. An authenticated user with create permission on the affected record type, such as HR User, can create records for employees outside their user-permission scope, including other companies' employees.

items.title: CVE-2026-126315: Frappe HRMS 16.14.0 before 16.20.1 sends product usage events on certain HR transactions without checking the site's telemetry setting, and some events include more detail than nee
items.summary: Frappe HRMS 16.14.0 before 16.20.1 sends product usage events on certain HR transactions without checking the site's telemetry setting, and some events include more detail than needed. During normal use, with no user action, values such as leave type names, claimed amounts and appraisal scores are transmitted even when telemetry is disabled.

items.title: CVE-2026-126316: Frappe HRMS from 16.0.0 before 16.20.1 contains an information exposure vulnerability that places the subscription key in the query string of outbound subscription status requests.
items.summary: Frappe HRMS from 16.0.0 before 16.20.1 contains an information exposure vulnerability that places the subscription key in the query string of outbound subscription status requests. Attackers with access to proxy, server, or monitoring logs along the request path can recover the site's subscription key from recorded URLs.

items.title: CVE-2026-126317: Frappe HRMS from 16.0.0 before 16.20.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read company details outside their permissions due to a mis
items.summary: Frappe HRMS from 16.0.0 before 16.20.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read company details outside their permissions due to a missing permission check. Any logged-in user, including Employee role users, can query the affected endpoint to list every company on the site along with its default currency.

items.title: CVE-2026-126318: REDAXO before 5.21.6 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows editors without the version[live_version] permission to modify live article versions by bypassing wo
items.summary: REDAXO before 5.21.6 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows editors without the version[live_version] permission to modify live article versions by bypassing working version enforcement. Authenticated editors can add, edit, delete, toggle, or reorder live slices via content/functions, slice ids, content_slice_status, content_move_slice, history restore, or content_copy, bypassing approval workflows.

items.title: CVE-2026-126307: Nezha Dashboard before 2.6.0 contains multiple authorization, tenant isolation, and resource exhaustion vulnerabilities that allow members or unauthenticated attackers to abuse NAT
items.summary: Nezha Dashboard before 2.6.0 contains multiple authorization, tenant isolation, and resource exhaustion vulnerabilities that allow members or unauthenticated attackers to abuse NAT, DDNS, OAuth, cron, and server transfer features. Attackers can claim undeclared Dashboard hostnames to capture login bodies, hijack DDNS profiles, create executable schedules without exec scope, or exhaust memory via buffered NAT requests.

items.title: CVE-2026-126308: The web dashboard in Coder 2.24.0 before 2.29.23, 2.30.0 before 2.34.14, 2.35.0 before 2.36.9, 2.37.0 before 2.37.6, and 2.38.0 before 2.38.2 replaces the $SESSION_TOKEN placeholde
items.summary: The web dashboard in Coder 2.24.0 before 2.29.23, 2.30.0 before 2.34.14, 2.35.0 before 2.36.9, 2.37.0 before 2.37.6, and 2.38.0 before 2.38.2 replaces the $SESSION_TOKEN placeholder in external app URLs with a full-access API key without checking whether the app belongs to a sub-agent. Code running in a workspace can register a disguised sub-agent app with a custom protocol URL, so the owner's click sends their API key to an attacker-chosen destination.

items.title: CVE-2026-126309: OpenBao before 2.6.5 and 2.7.2 contains a path traversal vulnerability in Transit key import that allows authenticated attackers to bypass name restrictions in ACL policies. Attack
items.summary: OpenBao before 2.6.5 and 2.7.2 contains a path traversal vulnerability in Transit key import that allows authenticated attackers to bypass name restrictions in ACL policies. Attackers limited by a required_parameters name constraint can craft traversal sequences during import to write key material under arbitrary Transit key names.

items.title: CVE-2026-126310: OpenBao before 2.6.5 and 2.7.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated callers to obtain OIDC ID tokens by abusing public clients with client_cr
items.summary: OpenBao before 2.6.5 and 2.7.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated callers to obtain OIDC ID tokens by abusing public clients with client_credentials enabled. Attackers who know a public client's client_id can request tokens from the identity/oidc/provider/ /token endpoint to impersonate the client without any secret.

items.title: CVE-2026-126311: OpenBao before 2.6.5 and 2.7.x before 2.7.2 does not neutralize wildcard characters in SSH certificate principals rendered from unvalidated external token metadata via identity tem
items.summary: OpenBao before 2.6.5 and 2.7.x before 2.7.2 does not neutralize wildcard characters in SSH certificate principals rendered from unvalidated external token metadata via identity templates in the SSH secrets engine. Attackers controlling that metadata, typically through a compromised identity provider, can inject '*' to obtain SSH certificates valid for multiple hosts or users.

items.title: CVE-2026-126312: OpenBao before 2.6.5 and 2.7.x before 2.7.2, and the openbao-plugins LDAP and RADIUS auth plugins before 0.2.0, contain an ACL bypass in the AppRole, Cert, LDAP, and RADIUS auth me
items.summary: OpenBao before 2.6.5 and 2.7.x before 2.7.2, and the openbao-plugins LDAP and RADIUS auth plugins before 0.2.0, contain an ACL bypass in the AppRole, Cert, LDAP, and RADIUS auth methods caused by implicit path canonicalization. Authenticated attackers can request non-canonical paths for AppRole Role IDs, Cert CRLs, LDAP groups and users, or RADIUS users to evade ACL deny rules.

items.title: CVE-2026-126301: NLTK from 3.6 before 3.10.4 contains an algorithmic complexity vulnerability in LegalitySyllableTokenizer.tokenize that allows remote attackers to exhaust CPU by supplying long all
items.summary: NLTK from 3.6 before 3.10.4 contains an algorithmic complexity vulnerability in LegalitySyllableTokenizer.tokenize that allows remote attackers to exhaust CPU by supplying long all-vowel tokens. Attackers can submit a token such as a long run of vowels, causing the unguarded onset reversal loop to perform quadratic work and deny service to syllabification components.

items.title: CVE-2026-126302: NLTK from 3.9.4 before 3.10.4 contains a symlink following vulnerability in nltk.sem.chat80.sql_query() that bypasses the pathsec data-root sandbox containment check. Attackers who
items.summary: NLTK from 3.9.4 before 3.10.4 contains a symlink following vulnerability in nltk.sem.chat80.sql_query() that bypasses the pathsec data-root sandbox containment check. Attackers who can write into a trusted NLTK data root can plant a symbolic link to read SQLite databases outside the sandbox.

items.title: CVE-2026-126303: NLTK before 3.10.4 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in SteppingRecursiveDescentParser.parse() that lacks any max_time deadline or step limit. Attackers i
items.summary: NLTK before 3.10.4 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in SteppingRecursiveDescentParser.parse() that lacks any max_time deadline or step limit. Attackers influencing the grammar can supply an ambiguous self-embedding grammar and short token input to force unbounded top-down search, pinning CPU cores and exhausting worker pools.

items.title: CVE-2026-126304: NLTK from 3.10.0 before 3.10.4 contains a symlink escape vulnerability in YCOECorpusReader that allows attackers to read files outside the corpus root by planting psd or pos direct
items.summary: NLTK from 3.10.0 before 3.10.4 contains a symlink escape vulnerability in YCOECorpusReader that allows attackers to read files outside the corpus root by planting psd or pos directory symlinks. Attackers controlling a YCOE corpus can make parsed_sents() and tagged_words() return file content from other corpora or temporary files within the NLTK data sandbox.

items.title: CVE-2026-126305: EspoCRM before 9.3.11 and 10.x before 10.0.9 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Knowledge Base articles that lets users with Knowledge Base create or edit acce
items.summary: EspoCRM before 9.3.11 and 10.x before 10.0.9 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Knowledge Base articles that lets users with Knowledge Base create or edit access attach a JavaScript file and add a crafted link to the article body. When an administrator clicks the link, the script runs in their session and can create an administrator account with attacker-chosen credentials.

items.title: CVE-2026-126306: EspoCRM before 9.3.11 and 10.x before 10.0.8 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows low-privileged users to upload crafted SVG images that submit authenti
items.summary: EspoCRM before 9.3.11 and 10.x before 10.0.8 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows low-privileged users to upload crafted SVG images that submit authenticated POST requests to arbitrary backend endpoints. Attackers can trick an administrator into opening the SVG in a separate browser tab and clicking it, performing administrator actions such as elevating the attacker's account to administrator.

items.title: CVE-2026-126295: NLTK from 3.10.0 before 3.10.4 contains an arbitrary file read vulnerability in BllipParser that allows attackers to open files outside NLTK data roots by supplying unvalidated mod
items.summary: NLTK from 3.10.0 before 3.10.4 contains an arbitrary file read vulnerability in BllipParser that allows attackers to open files outside NLTK data roots by supplying unvalidated model paths. Attackers controlling parser_model, reranker_features, reranker_weights, or from_unified_model_dir() input can make the bllipparser C extension read sensitive files or block on FIFOs and devices.

items.title: CVE-2026-126296: NLTK before 3.10.4 contains a path traversal vulnerability in save_maxent_params() and load_maxent_params() that bypasses the pathsec filesystem restriction mechanism. Attackers wh
items.summary: NLTK before 3.10.4 contains a path traversal vulnerability in save_maxent_params() and load_maxent_params() that bypasses the pathsec filesystem restriction mechanism. Attackers who control the tab_dir argument can read or overwrite model parameter files outside permitted data roots, because the functions call Python's built-in open() directly.

items.title: CVE-2026-126297: NLTK before 3.10.4 contains a quadratic-time denial of service vulnerability in ConllCorpusReader._get_srl_instances that allows remote attackers to exhaust CPU through nested span
items.summary: NLTK before 3.10.4 contains a quadratic-time denial of service vulnerability in ConllCorpusReader._get_srl_instances that allows remote attackers to exhaust CPU through nested span rescans. Attackers can supply a crafted CoNLL SRL corpus with many predicates and span columns, placing the head span last, to pin a core for minutes.

items.title: CVE-2026-126298: NLTK before 3.10.4 contains a denial of service vulnerability in Tree.chomsky_normal_form that allows remote attackers to exhaust CPU through quadratic-time right-factor binarizati
items.summary: NLTK before 3.10.4 contains a denial of service vulnerability in Tree.chomsky_normal_form that allows remote attackers to exhaust CPU through quadratic-time right-factor binarization using list.pop(0). Attackers can supply a wide flat treebank tree parsed by Tree.fromstring to force tens of seconds of single-threaded CPU consumption, blocking the processing thread.

items.title: CVE-2026-126299: NLTK before 3.10.4 contains a denial of service vulnerability in the CCG lexicon parser fromstring that allows remote attackers to exhaust CPU by supplying wide inputs. Attackers c
items.summary: NLTK before 3.10.4 contains a denial of service vulnerability in the CCG lexicon parser fromstring that allows remote attackers to exhaust CPU by supplying wide inputs. Attackers can submit lexicon text with long flat bracket bodies or operator chains, triggering quadratic string re-slicing in matchBrackets and augParseCategory that blocks worker threads.

items.title: CVE-2026-126300: NLTK from 3.2.5 before 3.10.4 contains an algorithmic complexity vulnerability in TreebankWordTokenizer.span_tokenize that allows remote attackers to cause quadratic CPU consumptio
items.summary: NLTK from 3.2.5 before 3.10.4 contains an algorithmic complexity vulnerability in TreebankWordTokenizer.span_tokenize that allows remote attackers to cause quadratic CPU consumption through repeated list.pop(0) calls. Attackers can submit long runs of double-quote characters to services span-tokenizing untrusted text, exhausting a CPU core and degrading availability.

items.title: CVE-2026-126290: NocoDB before 2026.07.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in base-integrations.service.ts that allows authenticated base members to read private integration configur
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.07.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in base-integrations.service.ts that allows authenticated base members to read private integration configurations by omitting a query flag. Attackers can request another user's private integration without the configuration flag, bypassing the ownership check to obtain stored connection credentials.

items.title: CVE-2026-126291: NocoDB before 2026.06.2 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in base-user.cte.utils.ts, which concatenates base members' email addresses into the SQL text of queries resolving u
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.06.2 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in base-user.cte.utils.ts, which concatenates base members' email addresses into the SQL text of queries resolving user, created-by or last-modified-by fields. Registered users can set an email with a quoted local part containing a single quote to execute arbitrary SQL, exposing user records, API tokens and data-source credentials.

items.title: CVE-2026-126292: NocoDB before 2026.06.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the profile update handler in users.service.ts, which returns the stored user record without passing it
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.06.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the profile update handler in users.service.ts, which returns the stored user record without passing it through the user-serialization filter, exposing the bcrypt password hash, salt, and session token counter. Attackers holding a stolen or hijacked session can update the profile to retrieve that account's password hash and salt for offline cracking.

items.title: CVE-2026-126293: NocoDB before 2026.06.2 contains an attachment size limit bypass that allows authenticated Editor users to store oversized files because data-attachment-v3.service.ts trusts the re
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.06.2 contains an attachment size limit bypass that allows authenticated Editor users to store oversized files because data-attachment-v3.service.ts trusts the remote server's advertised content length. Attackers can point the v3 upload-by-URL endpoint at a server that understates or omits its length to exhaust disk space or storage quota.

items.title: CVE-2026-125055: The Chatterbug Forms – Fast, Flexible WordPress Form Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Arbitrary File Upload in all versions up to, and including, 1.0.2 via the cbforms
items.summary: The Chatterbug Forms – Fast, Flexible WordPress Form Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Arbitrary File Upload in all versions up to, and including, 1.0.2 via the cbforms_check_form_submissions function. This is due to missing server-side file extension validation in cbforms_check_form_submissions(), where the allowed-type check defaults to the uploaded file's own extension when no field restriction is configured, trivially allowing any extension including .php. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to upload files that may be executable, which makes remote code execution possible. The submission nonce printed inline on every public page containing a Chatterbug form is freely obtainable by unauthenticated visitors and therefore does not constitute an effective access control barrier.

items.summary: The Passster – Password Protect Pages and Content plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'metavalue (metakeyinput=passster_id | passster_headline)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.3.21 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. A Contributor can break out of the shortcode attribute context by embedding a ] character in the passster_id or passster_headline meta value to prematurely close the opening shortcode tag, then append a [/passster] closing tag so that the trailing HTML payload is emitted verbatim by do_shortcode() — bypassing the per-attribute escaping present inside render_shortcode() — and the script will also execute in an editor's or administrator's browser when they preview the Contributor's pending post, since filter_the_content() has no edit-permission capability gate.

items.summary: The Recipe Card Blocks Lite plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'steps[].text' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.7.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. Because wp_kses_post() preserves block-delimiter HTML comments verbatim on save, a Contributor can embed event-handler payloads inside the block's steps[].text attribute in a draft or pending post without the unfiltered_html capability, and the payload executes for any visitor — including privileged editors and administrators who preview or publish the post — as well as through the public print endpoint.

items.summary: The EZ SQL Reports Shortcode Widget and DB Backup plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'HTTP_USER_AGENT (demonstrated); more generally, any attacker-controllable DB column the saved report selects' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 5.25.25 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. items.summary: The Customer Reviews for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Sensitive Information Exposure in versions up to, and including, 5.127.0 via the 'search' parameter of the cr_show_more_all_reviews and cr_show_more_reviews AJAX actions. This is due to the handlers being hooked on wp_ajax_nopriv_* without a capability check (and, in the product-page handler, with a nonce check that is behind a filter defaulting to false) while passing the visitor-supplied search string straight into get_comments() as the 'search' argument, which core expands into LIKE conditions over comment_author, comment_author_email, comment_author_url, comment_author_IP and comment_content. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to extract review author email addresses and IP addresses — fields WordPress and WooCommerce never expose to the public — one character at a time by observing whether the returned result set matches a probed substring.

items.title: CVE-2026-122063: The Newsletters plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to blind SQL Injection via the 'user_email' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.18.2 due to insufficient escaping o
items.summary: The Newsletters plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to blind SQL Injection via the 'user_email' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.18.2 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database. Exploitation requires the admin-controlled 'currentusersubscribed' option to be enabled and at least one page rendering the Newsletters subscribe shortcode or widget to exist; a Subscriber-level attacker can self-serve the attack by updating their own profile email to a crafted payload and loading such a page.

items.summary: The Easy Property Listings plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'post_type' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.5.28 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database. The sanitize_text_field() function is applied to the attribute value but does not escape single quotes, providing no mitigation against breaking out of the SQL IN('...') literal.

items.summary: The SureDash – Community, Courses & Member Dashboard plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including, 1.13.0 This is due to the `save_settings()` REST handler at `/suredash/v1/save-settings` being gated only by `admin_permission_callback()`, which authorizes any holder of the custom `manage_portal_dashboard` capability (Portal Manager role) without requiring `promote_users`, `edit_users`, or `manage_options`, combined with `sanitize_settings_data()` iterating all attacker-supplied keys with no allow-list, allowing arbitrary keys such as `default_role` to pass through `sanitize_text_field()` unchanged and be persisted into the `portal_settings` option via `update_option()` with no role-validity check. items.summary: The Drag and Drop File Upload for Elementor Forms plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to arbitrary file deletion due to insufficient file path validation in the remove_files function in all versions up to, and including, 1.6.2 This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to delete arbitrary files on the server, which can easily lead to remote code execution when the right file is deleted (such as wp-config.php). items.summary: The PowerPress Podcasting plugin by Blubrry plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'width' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 11.18.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. items.title: CVE-2026-119077: The ELEX WordPress HelpDesk & Customer Ticketing System plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to PHP Object Injection in all versions up to, and including, 3.3.9 via the 'form (specif
items.summary: The ELEX WordPress HelpDesk & Customer Ticketing System plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to PHP Object Injection in all versions up to, and including, 3.3.9 via the 'form (specifically the attacker-controlled ticket_label field inside the url-encoded form string)' parameter parameter. items.summary: The CF7 Apps – Honeypot, Database, Redirection, Webhook, and Addons for Contact Form 7 plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'wpcf7-form (CF7 form body; the [honeypot ...] tag value)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.8.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. items.summary: The WPeMatico RSS Feed Fetcher plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'post_category' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.9.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. items.title: CVE-2026-120658: The Download Manager plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'file[additional_previews][]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.6.3 d
items.summary: The Download Manager plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'file[additional_previews][]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.6.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. items.title: CVE-2026-115871: The WP STAGING – Backups & Restore, Migration & Clone Plugin – Cloud Backups, Scheduled Backups plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Arbitrary Directory Deletion in all versions u
items.summary: The WP STAGING – Backups & Restore, Migration & Clone Plugin – Cloud Backups, Scheduled Backups plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Arbitrary Directory Deletion in all versions up to, and including, 4.19.0. This is due to insufficient path validation in the `cleanStagingDirectory` function, where the `deleteDir` parameter is only stripped of whitespace and double slashes by `sanitizePath()` without removing `..` traversal sequences or enforcing containment within the staging directory, leaving the sole pre-deletion guard as a simple string equality check against the WordPress home path. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with administrator-level access and above, to recursively delete arbitrary directories on the server — including `wp-content`, `wp-admin`, or directories outside the WordPress installation on shared hosting — resulting in denial of service or permanent data loss. An attacker must sequence a clone start, cancellation, and restart to drive the `delete_job` cache into the `directory` step before re-cancelling with a manipulated `deleteDir` value supplied via the `wp_ajax_wpstg_cancel_clone` endpoint.

items.title: CVE-2026-116509: The Quiz and Survey Master (QSM) – Quiz Maker & Survey Maker plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'qpages' parameter in all versions up to, and inclu
items.summary: The Quiz and Survey Master (QSM) – Quiz Maker & Survey Maker plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'qpages' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 11.2.9 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database. The injected payload survives storage and a published-status check in display_shortcode() because a non-numeric ID causes the isPublished lookup to return an empty string, after which the payload is imploded directly into a WHERE question_id IN() clause via plain string interpolation with no wpdb->prepare() or esc_sql() call.

items.title: CVE-2026-116614: The WPMR Google Feed Manager for WooCommerce – Sell on Google Merchant Center & Shopping plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'sourceId' parameter in
items.summary: The WPMR Google Feed Manager for WooCommerce – Sell on Google Merchant Center & Shopping plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'sourceId' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.24.1 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with editor-level access and above, to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database. The plugin grants the edit_feeds capability to the Editor role on activation, meaning any Editor-level user satisfies the authorization checks and can exploit this vulnerability.

items.title: CVE-2026-116615: The Widget Options – Advanced Conditional Visibility for Gutenberg Blocks & Classic Widgets plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Code Injection in all versions up to, and includin
items.summary: The Widget Options – Advanced Conditional Visibility for Gutenberg Blocks & Classic Widgets plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Code Injection in all versions up to, and including, 4.2.6.1 via the `post_content` parameter. This is due to asymmetric parsing between the save-time strip filter (`widgetopts_strip_logic_from_blocks()`) and the render-time parser (`blockopts_filter_before_display()`): embedding an inner `<!--start_widgetopts` literal inside a JSON key causes the write-side `json_decode` to see a non-`class` key and skip stripping — persisting the payload verbatim to the database — while the render-side `str_replace` reconstitutes the key to `class`, feeding the attacker-controlled `logic` value directly into `@eval`. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Author-level access and above, to inject PHP expressions that execute on every front-end page view, enabling boolean-oracle exfiltration of WordPress site configuration data — including admin email address, default role, and arbitrary `get_option`, `get_user_meta`, and `get_post_meta` values — via the plugin's allowlisted-function sandbox, which escalates to unrestricted code execution if any install

items.title: CVE-2026-128637: The MISP Modules website component contains an open redirect vulnerability in its login endpoint. The /login route accepted a user-supplied next query parameter and passed it direc
items.summary: The MISP Modules website component contains an open redirect vulnerability in its login endpoint. The /login route accepted a user-supplied next query parameter and passed it directly to Flask's redirect() function without validating the destination. An attacker could craft a URL such as https://victim-host/login?next=https://attacker.example/phish and deliver it to a user (e.g., via email or a lookalike page). After the user successfully authenticated, the application issued a 302 redirect to the attacker-controlled external URL. This enables phishing attacks where a user, believing they are still on the legitimate MISP Modules site, may enter additional credentials or sensitive information on the attacker's page. It can also be used to obscure the true destination of a link, bypassing user trust in the legitimate domain. The vulnerability requires the victim to interact with the crafted URL and complete a login, but no prior authentication or special configuration is needed on the attacker's side. The affected component is the website sub-project of misp-modules, specifically the account blueprint in website/app/account/account.py. No version boundaries are specified in the patch

items.title: Policy and Disclosure: 2026 Edition
items.summary: Since 2021, Project Zero has followed a “90 + 30” vulnerability disclosure policy, allowing vendors up to 90 days to remediate a vulnerability plus an extra 30 days “soak time” for patch rollout. Our goal was to encourage faster patching and give vendors time to deliver patches to users. The advent of AI-assisted vulnerability discovery and exploitation has changed the threat landscape such that the vulnerability remediation timeline encouraged by our disclosure policy is clearly insufficient. LLMs have increased the speed at which attackers can find and exploit vulnerabilities, alongside the risk that multiple parties, including malicious ones, discover the same bug. A vulnerability reported today presents a much higher immediate risk to users than one reported last year. In this new environment, it is crucial that vendors move towards remediating vulnerabilities faster.

items.title: CVE-2026-128424: A flaw was found in Kroxylicious. The ACL authorizer's rules-file parser unquotes `matching /…/` regular-expression literals using the string unquoting rules, which strips every ba
items.summary: A flaw was found in Kroxylicious. The ACL authorizer's rules-file parser unquotes `matching /…/` regular-expression literals using the string unquoting rules, which strips every backslash escape. As a result, an allow rule such as `matching /orders\.v1/` is compiled as the regex `orders.v1`, which also matches unintended names such as `ordersXv1`, and character classes such as `\d` and `\w` lose their special meaning. Allow rules written with regex escapes can therefore apply to more resources than the author intended. Depending on the ACL configuration, this may allow an authenticated Kafka client to access a resource (such as read or write a topic) that should have been denied.

items.summary: MCUboot's Zephyr serial-recovery upload handler bs_upload() in boot/boot_serial/src/boot_serial.c decodes the host-supplied image field of an MCUmgr image-upload request into img_num (a full 32-bit value) and latches it on the off == 0 packet without any range check. items.summary: When MCUboot is built with the TinyCrypt crypto backend (MCUBOOT_USE_TINYCRYPT), bootutil_aes_ctr_drop() in boot/bootutil/include/bootutil/crypto/aes_ctr_tinycrypt.h was an empty stub. The AES-CTR context for this backend is the fully expanded AES-128 key schedule (struct tc_aes_key_sched_struct). Generic code relies on this hook to release and clear key state, so with TinyCrypt nothing was cleared. The mbedTLS and PSA backends do free or destroy their key state here. As a result, boot_state_clear(), which boot_go() calls before handing off to the application, left the image's AES content-encryption key schedule in the static boot_data state. This is the case after an encrypted upgrade in single-image builds, where boot_enc_zeroize() is not called. boot_decrypt_key() likewise left the ECIES-derived key-encryption key schedule on the stack. The affected build uses MCUBOOT_ENC_IMAGES with TinyCrypt, which is the default ECDSA and Ed25519 backend in the Zephyr port. The first AES-128 round key equals the cipher key, so anyone who can read the leftover bootloader RAM after boot can recover the image content key and decrypt that encrypted image. items.title: CVE-2026-127916: bootutil_img_hash() computes the image digest over ih_hdr_size + ih_img_size + ih_protect_tlv_size bytes, all three taken from the candidate image's header, and reads that span out
items.summary: bootutil_img_hash() computes the image digest over ih_hdr_size + ih_img_size + ih_protect_tlv_size bytes, all three taken from the candidate image's header, and reads that span out of the slot without checking that it fits in the flash area. The three sizes are also summed without an overflow check. Nothing earlier on the validation path bounds the whole span either: bootutil_img_validate() compares the image size against bootutil_max_image_size() only after the hash has been computed. The callers bound part of the span, or none of it: On the swap and overwrite upgrade path, boot_validate_slot() first runs the image header check (boot_is_header_valid(), later boot_check_header_valid()). Before MCUboot 2.2.0 that check covered only ih_hdr_size + ih_img_size, so for every image the protected-TLV area (ih_protect_tlv_size, a uint16_t, up to 65535 bytes) was hashed without being bounded.
